items.issue: The method treats refusal and repeated reluctance as problems to diagnose and overcome rather than possible endpoints.
items.disposition: Do not use as action advice. A clear no or repeated reluctance ends the proposal; one pressure-free clarification is the maximum.

items.issue: Firm imperative wording for movement to a home or hotel can suppress an easy refusal and is presented as superior to asking.
items.disposition: Keep do_not_generalize; any invitation must state the destination and leave an easy, respected decline.

items.issue: The live example shifts from a broad home invitation to the narrower stated purpose of feeding or seeing a dog after the woman raises a first-meeting objection.
items.disposition: Treat assent as limited to the stated purpose; do not infer sexual consent, arrival or success.

items.issue: Humor and ASD language frame safety and reputation concerns as defenses to bypass.
items.disposition: Do not recommend the jokes as objection-handling; humor may accompany, but never replace, accepting the answer.

items.issue: The causal claim that hesitation creates rejection and firmness produces yes is unsupported and can reward pressure.
items.disposition: Retain only as Mikey's hypothesis; separate calm self-expression from persistence or command.

items.issue: Attraction is used as a catch-all explanation that can erase safety, preference, logistics and autonomy.
items.disposition: Do not treat a no as evidence of insufficient attraction or as a technical failure to fix.

items.issue: Claimed hotel and private-space results appear in a course-promotion context without failures, sample definition or independent evidence.
items.disposition: Keep as unverified self-report; no effect or success claim.

items.issue: The participant's recording consent, privacy authorization and age are not established by the video.
items.disposition: Do not expose identity or infer authorization; keep visual use internal and restricted.

items.issue: ASR compresses long teaching segments, becomes unreliable after 731 seconds, and its final timestamp overshoots the 749.03-second media duration by 11.73 seconds.
items.disposition: Use the preserved stills and paraphrase; require original audio for exact dialogue after 731 seconds, and do not cite the overshooting tail as an exact media time.
